description: One keyword estimate: status (queued, running, done, failed) and per term the monthly matched-mention range (low, high), whether every platform has a number (complete), the monthly cost range, and per platform its status, reason (when skipped or failed), method (index or sample), monthly range and sample size.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.
